_doc.description: Coming Soon-only slice of The T content. Rendered by src/web/features/theT/components/ComingSoonPage.tsx. Field names mirror the canonical Static Upload Tubi Blog data — `eyebrow`, `subtitle`, `categoryTag`, `curatorTag`, `hero`, `slug` — so this file can be regenerated from the source JSONs without renaming. Section chrome (`{section}.header.title` + `{section}.header.subtitle`) is editorial copy authored alongside the slot data so the same JSON drives both the section heading and its content.
_doc.source: ~/Desktop/Static Upload Tubi Blog/{world-cup,single-titles}.json — every entry with `pageLocation: "Coming Soon"`. Top story is id 015 (world-cup.json), second story is id 019 (single-titles.json); the Arriving Soon rail draws from ids 016–018, the unlabeled More Titles rail from 020–022, and the closing Keep Reading rail from 023–025 (all single-titles.json).
_doc.doNotInclude: intro, whatsComing[], quote, whyWatchIt, whenToWatch, needAccount, whatDevices, datePosted, type, pageLocation — only the fields the Coming Soon page actually renders should ship in this chunk.
_doc.linking: Every article card / hero uses the canonical URL `/the-t/articles/<slug>`. Each slot stores just the bare `slug` (e.g. `fifa-world-cup-2026-on-tubi`); the renderer (`homePageData.ts → buildArticleHref`) prepends the prefix. The article route (`containers/Article.tsx`) fetches the matching JSON under `static/blog/the-t/data/articles/` and branches on its `type` field (`'article'` vs `'listicle'`) to dispatch to ArticleDetailsPage (single) or ArticleListPage (listicle), so the article kind is NOT duplicated here. The optional `watchLink` on some slots is reserved for future CTAs that route directly into the Tubi catalog; it does NOT influence the article href.
